record.provider: Audiovisual / heritage: Open Heritage 3D (CyArk + UC San Diego CHEI)

free_tier.stated: No published quota. The project is a consortium repository. 'we invite others to join the Open Heritage 3D project and contribute their datasets'. With 200+ datasets and DOIs under the 10.26301 prefix. Contribution is by organisational agreement, not self-serve signup.

egress.terms: Each project page lists its data types with sizes (10.3 GB of terrestrial LiDAR on a sampled project) and states that links to all available data types are emailed; no metering is stated.

record.tooling: Web catalogue with per-project pages and DOI resolution; no public upload API and no documented deposit endpoint. Joining requires contacting the consortium (CHEI at UCSD, CyArk, Politecnico di Torino G4CH, Washington and Lee).
record.chaining: Not chainable by an individual. The unit is an institutional partnership. A single organisation could contribute many datasets, but the door is a consortium agreement.

limits.value: invite others to join the Open Heritage 3D project and contribute their datasets

record.limits_note: Organisational membership required; heritage-3D scope (photogrammetry, laser scan, point clouds); no published per-file or total figures at all.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the about page invites others to join and contribute datasets but states no application form, fee or identity requirement

record.reliability_note: Stable academic consortium with DOI permanence and mirrored preservation, but there is no self-service path. This is a partnership, not a storage provider.
record.confidence_note: The 2026-11-03 evidence rows read https://openheritage3d.org/about (invitation to join and contribute datasets) and https://openheritage3d.org/project.php?id=07af-c325 (download links are emailed). No page read states that contribution is by organisational agreement, and the identity requirement is unverified, so the rung stays reported.
